notes: D1 oracle is official Auckland Transport passenger maps/PDFs/line pages, HAND-TRANSCRIBED. Stations arrays are not generated from GTFS. GTFS (https://gtfs.at.govt.nz/gtfs.zip, no key) is H2 name-clash only.
City stays planned. Modes v1: TRAIN only (Auckland Metro / AT trains). No bus, ferry, AirportLink, Northern Busway, or Te Huia in the oracle.
Timezone Pacific/Auckland HAS DST (NZDT/NZST). Do not copy Brisbane no-DST.

As of 24 Aug 2026 the live passenger product is still Southern / Eastern / Western / Onehunga. City Rail Link passenger services are confirmed to start Sunday 13 September 2026 (first weekday timetable Monday 14 September). Do not treat Te Waihorotiu or Karanga-a-Hape as open D1 stops. Do not flip the oracle to East West / South City / Onehunga West until that date.

Locked inner-city printed name: Waitematā Station (AT Waitematā Station page; network maps page; current timetables print Waitematā). Not Britomart, not Waitematā (Britomart), not Waitemata, not City Centre as a stop. Mana whenua gifted Waitematā to replace Britomart; dual-name stage ended; last-stage rename from Sep 2025.

Until CRL opens, Waitematā Station is the only city-centre commuter rail station. All lines except Onehunga arrive/depart Waitematā. Onehunga currently terminates at Newmarket (AT Onehunga West page: until end of Saturday 12 September, ONE runs Newmarket–Onehunga every 30 minutes).
Passenger codes on AT line pages: STH Southern, EAST Eastern, WEST Western, ONE Onehunga. Future codes S-C, E-W, O-W are preview-only.

Maungawhau (formerly Mount Eden) is printed on the Western timetable as temporarily closed for CRL construction. Not inserted on the current Western stations array. Future East West / Onehunga West pages list it after opening.

Paerātā and Drury Railway Stations opened Sunday 2 August 2026 on the Southern Line (AT/KiwiRail release 16 Jul 2026). Inserted. Ngākōroa Railway Station planned 2027 (South City preview: Under construction) — not inserted.

2017 line-route PDFs still linked from the maps index still say Britomart / Mt Eden / Te Papapa / Takanini. Do not use those strings as the 2026 lock. They are source for Onehunga corridor geography only.

2026 in-carriage map (23 Jun 2026) is the CRL-era product (South City / East West / Onehunga West plus Te Waihorotiu / Karanga-a-Hape). Coverage gap until 13 Sep. Map uses double-vowel macron spellings (Ngaakooroa, Paeraataa, Te Maahia) that differ from timetable macrons.
Te Huia (Hamilton–The Strand) is long-distance, not Auckland Metro D1.
gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown are passenger codes. H2 used public GTFS only to clash names. No stopIds in this file.
coverageGaps: City Rail Link not in passenger service as of 24 Aug 2026. Opens 13 Sep 2026. Te Waihorotiu and Karanga-a-Hape must not be treated as live D1 stops. Future lines East West (E-W), South City (S-C), Onehunga West (O-W) are official preview only.
Maungawhau (Mt Eden) currently closed for CRL construction (Western timetable legend). Not on current WEST stop list.
Ngākōroa: official South City preview prints Under construction; AT Drury/Paerātā release says planned 2027. Not inserted.

Current Southern all-stops PDF linked from some AT pages (n44gnojn) is a 27–28 Sep 2025 rail-bus overlay and omits Paerātā/Drury. Oracle uses AT 2 Aug 2026 opening copy plus the South City preview corridor for those two names.
2017 Eastern/Southern/Western/Onehunga route-map PDFs still linked from the maps index are stale (Britomart branding).
Te Huia The Strand is out of v1.
PDF hex colours are feed/legend metadata, not D1 print locks.
